top_signals.title: Peru Indigenous Group Bids for Part of China-Owned Copper Mine
top_signals.summary: An Indigenous community in Peru is proposing to buy part of a copper concession from MMG Ltd. and turn thousands of artisanal miners operating there into formal suppliers to the Chinese-owned company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Michael Palin on Still Traveling the World at 83
top_signals.summary:
"I'm at the stage of not knowing whether I'm going to travel again."

Actor Michael Palin opens up to Mishal Husain about the challenges of visiting some of the toughest countries at 83-years-old. (Source: Bloomberg)
